sources.text: Our mission is to advance the understanding of brain function and its relation to neuropsychiatric disorders through innovative research in gene expression regulation Our Approach We integrate advanced genomic methods with diverse experimental models to explore brain development, response to environment, and susceptibility to disorders like addiction. Learn More Lab Values Our lab fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and inclusivity through comprehensive training and mentorship. We emphasize intellectual curiosity, integrity, and a collaborative spirit, believing these are key to achieving scientific excellence and contributing positively to the scientific community. Meet the team We welcome the support from individuals and organizations who share our vision. Your donations can make a profound impact, aiding us in acquiring advanced equipment, supporting researchers, and propelling new discoveries. Welcome to my UCSD profile! Our laboratory is focused on studying the mechanisms of gene regulation that contribute to neuronal plasticity and behavior. By gaining a deeper understanding of these mechanisms, we strive to advance our fundamental understanding of brain function and pave the way for novel therapeutic approaches for brain diseases, particularly substance use disorders. Our interdisciplinary approach combines molecular, cellular, and behavioral studies with state-of-the-art functional genomics techniques. Through these methods, we aim to dissect the tissue- and cell type-specific gene regulatory mechanisms that underlie the neurobiology of substance use disorders.
